events.verdict: Gobert (MIN) establishes himself in Alvarado's (NOP) path prior to the contact.
Queen (NOP) brings two hands to the ball and loses control of the ball after his gather. He then legally regains possession of the ball and does not resume his dribble.
Gobert (MIN) applies his right hand to Bey's (NOP) side and immediately removes his hand as he defends the shot attempt.
Reid (MIN) legally touches the ball after establishing himself in the frontcourt.
Edwards (MIN) extends his forearm into Alvarado's (NOP) upper body and delivers contact that affects his ability to defend.
Queen (NOP) firms up over his left leg in McDaniels' (MIN) path prior to the contact.
McDaniels (MIN) grazes Queen's (NOP) arm as he defends the shot at the basket.
Edwards (MIN) and Alvarado (NOP) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
Murphy III (NOP) moves alongside DiVincenzo's (MIN) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Queen (NOP) legally contests DiVincenzo's (MIN) tip-in attempt at the basket.
DiVincenzo (MIN) makes contact with the ball and with the part of Alvarado's (NOP) hand that is on the ball.
Queen (NOP) legally contests McDaniels' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Fears (NOP) braces for the contact from Gobert (MIN) and the contact during the shot attempt is marginal.
Gobert (MIN) maintains verticality as he defends Fears' (NOP) shot attempt.
Alvarado (NOP) dislodges the ball from Edwards (MIN).
Edwards (MIN) brings his hands towards Alvarado (NOP) as he releases away to receive the pass.

Murphy III (NOP) grazes the top of Edwards' (MIN) head during the driving shot attempt. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Gobert (MIN) momentarily applies his right forearm to Queen's (NOP) upper body, and he immediately removes his forearm as Queen enters his upward shooting motion.
